owned_module_verification.method: Owner-reported diode-test observations: eleven independent lit dots cover all12 terminals
owned_module_verification.front_orientation: Printed part-number label on LEFT with seven-dot axis vertical and chosen TOP uppermost

bc12.good_bat: Always-on +3V3 hard tie; keeps SDP/CDP USB switches connected during display-rail shutdown and host suspend
bc12.supply: +5V after U8 input soft start, never VLED_5V
bc12.sw_open: Pin1 intentionally no-connect; switch closes automatically for SDP/CDP when GOOD_BAT HIGH
bc12.detector_logic: CHG_DET HIGH is3.5V..VBUS; R21/R22 translate it to BC_DET; CHG_AL_N open-drain LOW means allowed
bc12.grant_rule: Grant project500mA/full brightness only for BC_DET HIGH AND BC_AL_N LOW after a positive stable detector state; real host suspend overrides BC and CC

truth_table.result: Low-current/SDP or unqualified; no BC high-current grant; configured host or CC handled independently
Positive high-current charger classification; cap project current at500mA
Charging not allowed by detector; withdraw BC grant immediately
Charging not allowed/inconsistent; fail closed, never grant500mA

bc12.qualification_notes: Power-up/reset begins unqualified; require valid stable status before raising load; withdraw on either status changing. Slow insertion beyond600ms can conservatively remain dim.

protocol.wire_bit_order: MSB first (OUT15 first within each word)
protocol.gate_bit_polarity: 1=sink enabled=PMOS gate LOW=column ON; exactly one gate bit in active phases
protocol.latch: level-sensitive HIGH, LOW while shifting; pulse HIGH then LOW while BLANK is HIGH

scan.default: Prototype unknown-source DIM at25us light per500us phase; measured<100mA budget not yet qualified; compile-time unknown-source OFF alternative available

input_soft_start.qualification: Measure whole assembly USB input current/charge, including stock XIAO mux and LDO startup

power.initial_output_state: DRIVER_EN pulled LOW; both LED rails OFF
power.suspend: BLANK HIGH; wait>=30us; SIN/SCLK/LAT LOW; BLANK input high-Z no pulls; DRIVER_EN LOW; MCU USB suspend/clock/power policy still requires bench qualification
power.wake: BLANK input high-Z no pulls; SIN/SCLK/LAT LOW; DRIVER_EN HIGH; wait>=10ms; BLANK HIGH; shift/latch 64 zero bits; begin authorized scan
power.off_input_rule: Never drive a logic HIGH into an unpowered TLC; BLANK pullup is to SW_3V3 only
